highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Webster University is a private, nonprofit university in the US, offering over 160 undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes. You can benefit from a personalised, small-campus community while having easy access to the major metropolitan area of St. Louis.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At Webster, you can choose from 100+ student clubs and organisations, including cultural groups, arts, athletics and academic clubs. Webster supports both residential and commuter students with services including academic support, counselling, and more.

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Emerson Library at Webster University offers you several resources and study areas.

Sports
The University Centre is the heart of the sports facilities, where you can find a fitness centre, the Grant Gymnasium, an indoor pool, and more. Webster offers a wide range of varsity sports, including soccer, basketball, and more.

Laboratory
You can find multiple specialised lab facilities at Webster, including the Science Building (Browning Hall) and the School of Communications.

Cafeteria
The university’s main dining hall, Marletto’s Marketplace, is where you can find fresh food with meal plans and comfortable spaces to eat.
